title: Lemon, Potato and Sage Focaccia
changes_from_base: Garlic and lemon-zest oil, thinly sliced waxy potato and a little sage on top.
summary: Focaccia brushed with a garlic and lemon-zest oil and layered with paper-thin potatoes and torn sage.
equipment: cling film or a clean tea towel

ingredients.item: unwaxed lemons, finely grated zest only

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Stir the flour, yeast, fine salt, warm water and 2 tbsp oil into a wet dough, cover and leave 15 min.

steps.title: Folds
steps.text: Work through four sets of folds at 30 min intervals until the dough is smooth and lively.

steps.title: Lemon oil
steps.text: Mix the 4 tbsp oil with the grated garlic and lemon zest and leave it to infuse while the dough rises.

steps.title: Tin
steps.text: Brush half the lemon oil over the tin, add the dough, flip it and stretch it out. Cover and let it puff for about 1 h.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Slice the potatoes 2 mm thick and toss with the rest of the lemon oil. Thin slices cook through in the time the bread takes and curl at the edges.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C (210 °C fan). Dimple the dough, overlap the potato slices on top, tuck in the sage and season with flaky salt and pepper. Bake 28-32 min, until the potatoes are tender and browned at the rims; the centre reads about 96 °C. Cool 15 min before slicing.

tips: Slice the potatoes evenly thin; thick slices stay hard in the time the bread takes.
Use unwaxed lemons, or scrub waxed ones in hot water before zesting.
Overlap the potato slices only slightly so the dough can still rise between them.
storage: Best on the day. Keep in the fridge for up to 2 days and reheat at 200 °C for 6 min; freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
